##     ⚠️⚠️⚠️ NOTE ABOUT THE INSTRUCTIONS ⚠️⚠️⚠️  

You can add more categories and/or more words under the existing categories, but make sure you keep the same format.

>
>Category: YourCategory  
>Words: Word1, Word2, Word3 etc.
>
>
The Gemini model seems to have bias for certain categories/words. For example Cyberpunk and Art Nouveau seems to be more common than other words in the "Setting" category. This can be countered by either removing the words or by adding Example Prompts and use other words from the categories in those examples. It's important that the structure is followed here as well.  
>**Partially Written Prompt:** A lonely "Subject" "Expression" in the style of "Style"  
>**Input Words (Selected):** Subject: girl, Expression: smirking, Style: Renaissance  
>**Generated Prompt:** A lonely girl smirking in the style of renaissance.  
>
I have also had some issued with Gemini resusing the same prompt over and over, and I haven't found any reliable way to prevent this. Sometimes it can go 10+ prompts without any repeats, and sometimes it start repeating immediately. To break the repeats, you can make some small change in the input text.  

I added the "Lora" category as a way to make sure any triggerword is included. When you use a lora that require triggerwords, you need to add the triggerword under the "Lora" category in "Gemini 2.0 Instructions"  
>
>Category: Lora  
>Words: Triggerword
